name: The Qing conquest of Dzungaria
traveler: Zhaohui and the Qianlong emperor's armies
summary: The Qianlong emperor sends armies into Dzungaria and the Tarim basin, destroying the last steppe empire; most of the Dzungar people die in the war and the epidemics that follow. The new territory is called Xinjiang, 'new frontier', and surveyed by Jesuit and Chinese mapmakers.

stops.note: The Qing armies assemble in the north-west.
The Dzungar capital falls without a fight.
The rebel Amursana flees to Russia; the Dzungars are destroyed.
The Tarim oases, under the Khoja brothers, resist.
Zhaohui is besieged at the 'Black Water camp' before relief arrives.
Kashgar is taken; the Khojas flee to Badakhshan.
